body.objective: Add typed estimates for parameter-dependent polyhomogeneous oscillatory endpoint bases and wave-packet null traces, so formal Schwarzschild mode heads can be promoted to bounded Iplus/Iminus trace operators without confusing a coordinate current density with boundary flux.
body.stop_condition: Provide uniform joint (z,omega) symbol bounds, including omega derivatives and threshold exclusions, for finite matrix-valued polyhomogeneous expansions with phases exp(+-i*omega/z) and z^(i*c*omega). Provide a stationary-phase/integration-by-parts theorem that turns Schwartz or declared weighted-L2 spectral amplitudes into endpoint traces with certified remainder and conserved quadratic flux. The API must type Iplus and Iminus separately, retain orientation, return continuity/norm bounds, and compose with validated connection-matrix enclosures. Include exact scalar controls, a 2x2 matrix control, endpoint-mixing and omitted-omega-derivative mutations, and a refusal when only fixed-frequency formal heads are supplied.
body.forbid: no monochromatic generalized mode called a finite-energy state; no improper Fv integral called null flux; no mixing Iplus and Iminus test polarizations; no interchange of limit and frequency integral without a bound; no sampled-frequency smoothness claim; no interval overlap called equality; no physics-specific Schwarzschild equations in lib/math
body.resource_hint: The physics preflight has exact endpoint phase assignments and an exact six-state radial current. The missing object is the functional-analytic trace estimate, not another fixed-frequency asymptotic coefficient table.
notes: Keep exact formal asymptotics, validated numerical connection evidence and analytic wave-packet estimates as distinct evidence types.
The first consumer uses omega in [1/2,3/4], but the design should expose threshold exclusions rather than hard-code that interval.
